item.title: UBS: Building the Universal Beach Scanner for Gold, Rings, and Shark Teeth
item.description: Explore how a Universal Beach Scanner could combine multi-frequency metal detection, radar sensing, and machine learning to identify rings, rare metals, and even non-metallic beach finds like shark teeth—plus a practical build roadmap, cost models, and engineering trade-offs.
item.author: ericdequevedo@gmailcom (Eric deQuevedo)
